experiences.title: Classify the data
experiences.description: Teach a tiny "model" to sort points into Category A or B.

experiences.title: Style a button
experiences.description: Change a button's colour and text and see the result instantly.

experiences.title: Sorting challenge
experiences.description: Put the bars in order using as few swaps as you can.

experiences.title: Logic puzzle
experiences.description: Follow a few lines of pseudo-code and predict the output.

experiences.title: Organise the data
experiences.description: Drag pieces of information into the right database table.

experiences.title: Connect the network
experiences.description: Link Computer, Router and Server in the right order.

experiences.title: Build a mini web page
experiences.description: Customise a simple page and watch it update.

experiences.title: Send it to the cloud
experiences.description: Upload a file to the cloud, then open it from another device.

experiences.title: Password strength lab
experiences.description: Type a password and watch the strength meter.

experiences.title: Spot the phishing message
experiences.description: Two messages: which one looks suspicious?

experiences.title: Mini investigation
experiences.description: Read a fictional log and find who did it.

experiences.title: Find the weakness
experiences.description: A safe, fictional puzzle: which setting is the security hole?

experiences.title: Drive the robot
experiences.description: Move a robot on a grid to the goal.

experiences.title: LED board
experiences.description: Switch virtual LEDs on and off with buttons.

experiences.title: Logic gates
experiences.description: Switch inputs and see how AND / OR gates respond.

experiences.title: Camera detects an object
experiences.description: Move an object in front of a virtual camera.

experiences.title: Photo filters
experiences.description: Apply grayscale and other filters to a picture.

quiz_questions.question: What would you rather spend an afternoon doing?
Which problem would you enjoy solving most?
In a team project, which job would you volunteer for?
What do you care about most in technology?

quiz_options.option_text: Building a physical device or robot
Making an app smarter at predicting things
Organising data so a team can find it fast
Figuring out how an intruder got in
Making a machine react to the real world
A code editor and an algorithms book
Setting up the servers, site and database
Solving hard problems with code and math
Making systems reliable and useful for people
Keeping people and their data safe
